descriptions.f13a_clip_list_800e2464: Parse the original mesh clip-list syntax using a 256-byte name buffer and a four-byte integer clip output: ignore spaces, start a clip on plus/comma separators, use comma to enable the next blend, recognize the colon-prefixed control marker, and apply the observed integer control flag to each started clip including the final token. Preserve the signed-character dispatch, per-iteration output-pointer lifetime, original unbounded name-copy behavior, and four-byte output footprint verified through the native clip-play helper. Mesh and registry types remain external receiver views; no game object is allocated.
